Based on github.com/anytls/sing-anytls v0.0.11, under the original GPL-3.0-or-later
license in LICENSE. This local replacement keeps the existing protocol version
and API; it does not modify the shared Go module cache.

Local changes (2026-11-21):
- Publish Stream's terminal error atomically. Read/Write may run concurrently
  with local Close, a remote FIN, and session shutdown.
- Install the client's stream close hook before publishing the stream to the
  receive loop. The hook is immutable until the winning close operation runs.
- Finish stream removal/FIN before returning the session to its idle pool.

Reproduction: root module's TestSubscriptionTLSConnectionProtocols/anytls with
the Go race detector. Additional focused tests are in session/stream_test.go.
When updating the upstream module, compare these fixes and run both test sets
before removing this replacement.
